answers.quote: There is a constitutional requirement in India (Article 112) to present before the Parliament a statement of estimated receipts and expenditures of the government in respect of every financial year which runs from 1 April to 31 March. This 'Annual Financial Statement' constitutes the main budget document of the government.
answers.notes: Article 112 in c01.

answers.quote: There is a constitutional requirement in India (Article 112) to present before the Parliament a statement of estimated receipts and expenditures of the government in respect of every financial year which runs from 1 April to 31 March. This 'Annual Financial Statement' constitutes the main budget document of the government.
answers.notes: FY 1 April-31 March in c01.

answers.answer: সরকারের সম্পদ ও দায় সংক্রান্ত লেনদেন
answers.quote: There is a need therefore to have two accounts those that relate to the current financial year only are included in the revenue account (also called revenue budget) and those that concern the assets and liabilities of the government into the capital account (also called capital budget).
answers.notes: Capital account = assets/liabilities per c02.

answers.quote: Government provides certain goods and services which cannot be provided by the market mechanism i.e. by exchange between individual consumers and producers. Examples of such goods are national defence, roads, government administration etc. which are referred to as public goods.
answers.notes: National defence listed as public good in c03.

answers.answer: এটি বার্ষিক আর্থিক বিবৃতির সঙ্গে পেশ করা হয় এবং এতে বাজেটে প্রস্তাবিত করের আরোপ, বাতিল, ছাড় বা পরিবর্তনের বিবরণ থাকে
answers.quote: A Finance Bill, presented along with the Annual Financial Statement, provides details on the imposition, abolition, remission, alteration or regulation of taxes proposed in the Budget.
answers.notes: Finance Bill presented with AFS, tax details per c11.

answers.quote: The government sector affects the personal disposable income of households by making transfers and collecting taxes. It is through this that the government can change the distribution of income and bring about a distribution that is considered 'fair' by society. This is the redistribution function.
answers.notes: Stmt 1 = redistribution (c04); stmt 2 = stabilisation (c05). Both true.

answers.answer: কর আদায় ও হস্তান্তর-প্রদানের মাধ্যমে পরিবারের ব্যয়যোগ্য আয় বদলে দিয়ে
answers.quote: The government sector affects the personal disposable income of households by making transfers and collecting taxes. It is through this that the government can change the distribution of income and bring about a distribution that is considered 'fair' by society. This is the redistribution function.
answers.notes: Transfers + taxes change disposable income per c04.

answers.answer: এটি সরকারের ওপর কোনো দাবি তৈরি করে না
answers.quote: Revenue Receipts: Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government. They are therefore termed nonredeemable. They are divided into tax and nontax revenues.
answers.notes: Revenue receipts do not lead to a claim, non-redeemable, per c06.

answers.answer: যে প্রাপ্তি দায় তৈরি করে বা আর্থিক সম্পদ কমিয়ে দেয়
answers.quote: All those receipts of the government which create liability or reduce financial assets are termed as capital receipts.
answers.notes: Capital receipts create liability or reduce financial assets per c12.

answers.quote: Nondebt creating capital receipts are those receipts which are not borrowings and, therefore, do not give rise to debt. Examples are recovery of loans and the proceeds from the sale of PSUs.
answers.notes: Sale of PSUs listed as non-debt creating capital receipt in c20; disinvestment reduces financial assets per c13.

answers.quote: Revenue Expenditure is expenditure incurred for purposes other than the creation of physical or financial assets of the central government. It relates to those expenses incurred for the normal functioning of the government departments and various services, interest payments on debt incurred by the government, and grants given to state governments and other parties
answers.notes: Interest payments are revenue expenditure per c14 (also c15).

answers.answer: সরকারের দেওয়া ঋণের সুদ-প্রাপ্তি, বিনিয়োগ থেকে লভ্যাংশ ও মুনাফা, সেবার জন্য ফি
answers.quote: Nontax revenue of the central government mainly consists of interest receipts on account of loans by the central government, dividends and profits on investments made by the government, fees and other receipts for services rendered by the government.
answers.notes: Exact list in c10.

answers.quote: There are expenditures of the government which result in creation of physical or financial assets or reduction in financial liabilities. This includes expenditure on the acquisition of land, building, machinery, equipment, investment in shares, and loans and advances by the central government to state and union territory governments, PSUs and other parties.
answers.notes: A-2 (c06 tax/non-tax receipts), B-3 (c12 borrowing creates liability), C-4 (c14/c15 interest, pensions), D-1 (c16 land, machinery).

answers.answer: যে ব্যয়ে শারীরিক বা আর্থিক সম্পদ তৈরি হয় অথবা আর্থিক দায় কমে
answers.quote: There are expenditures of the government which result in creation of physical or financial assets or reduction in financial liabilities. This includes expenditure on the acquisition of land, building, machinery, equipment, investment in shares, and loans and advances by the central government to state and union territory governments, PSUs and other parties.
answers.notes: Definition verbatim in c16.

answers.quote: Revenue Deficit: The revenue deficit refers to the excess of government's revenue expenditure over revenue receipts. Revenue deficit = Revenue expenditure - Revenue receipts
answers.notes: Formula verbatim in c18.

answers.answer: মোট ব্যয় − (রাজস্ব প্রাপ্তি + ঋণ-বহির্ভূত মূলধনী প্রাপ্তি)
answers.quote: Fiscal Deficit: Fiscal deficit is the difference between the government's total expenditure and its total receipts excluding borrowing. Gross fiscal deficit = Total expenditure - (Revenue receipts + Nondebt creating capital receipts)
answers.notes: Formula verbatim in c19.

answers.quote: It is simply the fiscal deficit minus the interest payments. Gross primary deficit = Gross fiscal deficit - Net interest liabilities
answers.notes: Fiscal deficit minus interest payments per c22.

answers.answer: কারণ রাজকোষ ঘাটতি মেটাতে সরকারকে ঋণ নিতেই হয়; এটি সব উৎস মিলিয়ে মোট ঋণ-প্রয়োজন নির্দেশ করে
answers.quote: The fiscal deficit will have to be financed through borrowing. Thus, it indicates the total borrowing requirements of the government from all sources.
answers.notes: Fiscal deficit financed through borrowing = total borrowing requirements per c23.

answers.quote: Item 3 in Table 5.1 shows that revenue deficit in 2022-23 was 3.8 per cent of GDP. The fiscal deficit, therefore turn out to be 6.4 per cent of GDP.
answers.notes: Fiscal deficit 6.4% of GDP in 2022-23 per c24 (3.8% was revenue deficit).

answers.answer: সরকারি বন্ড সঞ্চয়ের জন্য বেসরকারি বন্ডের সঙ্গে প্রতিযোগিতা করায় কিছু বেসরকারি ঋণগ্রহীতা আর্থিক বাজার থেকে ছিটকে পড়ে
answers.quote: if the government decides to borrow from private citizens by issuing bonds to finance its deficits, these bonds will compete with corporate bonds and other financial instruments for the available supply of funds. Thus, some private borrowers will get 'crowded out' of the financial markets as the government claims an increasing share of the economy's total savings.
answers.notes: Crowding out described verbatim in c27.

answers.answer: A ও R দুটোই সঠিক এবং R হল A-এর সঠিক ব্যাখ্যা
answers.also_defensible: A ও R দুটোই সঠিক, কিন্তু R, A-এর সঠিক ব্যাখ্যা নয়
answers.quote: From the way gross fiscal deficit is measured as given above, it can be seen that revenue deficit is a part of fiscal deficit
answers.notes: c21 states revenue deficit is part of fiscal deficit as seen from the way fiscal deficit is measured (formula in c19 = R), so R explains A; the both-true-but-not-explanation option is also arguable.

answers.quote: The enactment of the FRBMA, in August 2003, marked a turning point in fiscal reforms, binding the government through an institutional framework to pursue a prudent fiscal policy. The rules under the Act were notified with effect from July, 2004.
answers.notes: Order: FRBMA enacted Aug 2003 (c31), rules July 2004 (c31), RBI primary-issue bar from 2006-07 (c33), revenue deficit elimination target 31 Mar 2009 (c32).

answers.quote: Tax revenues, an important component of revenue receipts, have for long been divided into direct taxes (personal income tax) and firms (corporation tax), and indirect taxes like excise taxes (duties levied on goods produced within the country), customs duties (taxes imposed on goods imported into and exported out of India) and service tax
answers.notes: Personal income tax is a direct tax per c07.

answers.quote: Tax revenues, an important component of revenue receipts, have for long been divided into direct taxes (personal income tax) and firms (corporation tax), and indirect taxes like excise taxes (duties levied on goods produced within the country), customs duties (taxes imposed on goods imported into and exported out of India) and service tax
answers.notes: Customs duties listed among indirect taxes in c07.

answers.answer: ভারতে আমদানি হওয়া ও ভারত থেকে রপ্তানি হওয়া পণ্যের ওপর
answers.quote: Tax revenues, an important component of revenue receipts, have for long been divided into direct taxes (personal income tax) and firms (corporation tax), and indirect taxes like excise taxes (duties levied on goods produced within the country), customs duties (taxes imposed on goods imported into and exported out of India) and service tax
answers.notes: Customs on goods imported into and exported out of India per c07.

answers.answer: আয় যত বেশি, করের হার তত বেশি
answers.quote: The redistribution objective is sought to be achieved through progressive income taxation, in which higher the income, higher is the tax rate. Firms are taxed on a proportional basis, where the tax rate is a particular proportion of profits.
answers.notes: Progressive: higher income, higher tax rate per c08.

answers.answer: সম্পদ কর, উপহার কর ও এস্টেট ডিউটিকে
answers.quote: Other direct taxes like wealth tax, gift tax and estate duty (now abolished) have never brought in large amount of revenue and thus have been referred to as 'paper taxes'.
answers.notes: Wealth tax, gift tax, estate duty called paper taxes in c09.

answers.quote: Tax revenues, an important component of revenue receipts, have for long been divided into direct taxes (personal income tax) and firms (corporation tax), and indirect taxes like excise taxes (duties levied on goods produced within the country), customs duties (taxes imposed on goods imported into and exported out of India) and service tax
answers.notes: Pair 3 is wrong: customs is indirect (c07). Pairs 1 (c44), 2 (c07), 4 (c09) are correct.

answers.quote: Goods and Service Tax (GST) is the single comprehensive indirect tax, operational from 1 July 2017, on supply of goods and services, right from the manufacturer/ service provider to the consumer. It is a destination based consumption tax with facility of Input Tax Credit in the supply chain.
answers.notes: GST operational from 1 July 2017 per c34.

answers.quote: Goods and Service Tax (GST) is the single comprehensive indirect tax, operational from 1 July 2017, on supply of goods and services, right from the manufacturer/ service provider to the consumer. It is a destination based consumption tax with facility of Input Tax Credit in the supply chain.
answers.notes: GST is the single comprehensive indirect tax per c34.

answers.answer: কর ভোগের গন্তব্যে জমে; আগের ধাপের করের ক্রেডিট পরের ধাপে বাদ পাওয়ায় কর পড়ে শুধু মূল্য-সংযোজনে
answers.quote: Goods and Service Tax (GST) is the single comprehensive indirect tax, operational from 1 July 2017, on supply of goods and services, right from the manufacturer/ service provider to the consumer. It is a destination based consumption tax with facility of Input Tax Credit in the supply chain.
answers.notes: Destination-based consumption tax with ITC per c34; ITC makes it a tax on value addition per c35.

answers.quote: Some of the major taxes that were levied by Centre were Central Excise Duty, Service Tax, Central Sales Tax, Cesses like KKC and SBC. The major State taxes were VAT/Sales Tax, Entry Tax, Luxury Tax, Octroi, Entertainment Tax, Taxes on Advertisements, Taxes on Lottery /Betting/ Gambling, State Cesses on goods etc. These have been subsumed in GST.
answers.notes: Central Excise Duty subsumed per c36.

answers.answer: পাঁচটি পেট্রোলিয়াম পণ্য আপাতত GST-র বাইরে রাখা হয়েছে
answers.quote: Five petroleum products have been kept out of GST for the time being but with passage of time, they will get subsumed in GST. State Governments will continue to levy VAT on alcoholic liquor for human consumption.
answers.notes: Five petroleum products kept out for the time being per c37.

answers.quote: GST Council - Constitution (Article 279A of the Constitution) Chairperson - Union FM ... Members MOS (Finance) and all Ministers of Finance / Taxation of each State ... Decision by 75% majority States - 2/3 weightage and Centre - 1/3 weightage
answers.notes: Chairperson is Union Finance Minister per c41.

answers.quote: GST Council - Constitution (Article 279A of the Constitution) Chairperson - Union FM ... Members MOS (Finance) and all Ministers of Finance / Taxation of each State ... Decision by 75% majority States - 2/3 weightage and Centre - 1/3 weightage
answers.notes: Both statements verbatim in c41: 75% majority; States 2/3, Centre 1/3.

answers.quote: GST Council - Constitution (Article 279A of the Constitution) Chairperson - Union FM ... Members MOS (Finance) and all Ministers of Finance / Taxation of each State ... Decision by 75% majority States - 2/3 weightage and Centre - 1/3 weightage
answers.notes: Pair 4 is mismatched: GST Council is under Article 279A (c41); Article 112 is the budget/AFS (c01). Pairs 1 (c38/c40), 2 (c40), 3 (c41) are correct.

answers.quote: all revenues received by the Government of India, all loans raised by that Government by the issue of treasury bills, loans or ways and means advances and all moneys received by that Government in repayment of loans shall form one consolidated fund to be entitled 'the Consolidated Fund of India'
answers.notes: Consolidated Fund of India under Article 266 per c45.

answers.quote: Parliament may by law establish a Contingency Fund in the nature of an imprest to be entitled 'the Contingency Fund of India' ... the said Fund shall be placed at the disposal of the President to enable advances to be made by him out of such Fund for the purposes of meeting unforeseen expenditure pending authorisation of such expenditure by Parliament by law
answers.notes: Contingency Fund placed at disposal of the President per c47.

answers.answer: ভারতের সরকারি হিসাবে (Public Account of India)
answers.quote: All other public moneys received by or on behalf of the Government of India or the Government of a State shall be credited to the public account of India or the public account of the State, as the case may be. No moneys out of the Consolidated Fund of India or the Consolidated Fund of a State shall be appropriated except in accordance with law
answers.notes: All other public moneys credited to Public Account per c46.

answers.answer: একজন সভাপতি ও অন্য চারজন সদস্য, সকলেই রাষ্ট্রপতির নিযুক্ত
answers.quote: The President shall, within two years from the commencement of this Constitution and thereafter at the expiration of every fifth year or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary, by order constitute a Finance Commission which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be appointed by the President.
answers.notes: Chairman + four other members appointed by President per c49.

answers.answer: রাষ্ট্রপতি প্রতিটি সুপারিশ, গৃহীত পদক্ষেপের ব্যাখ্যামূলক স্মারকসহ, সংসদের উভয় কক্ষে পেশ করাবেন
answers.quote: The President shall cause every recommendation made by the Finance Commission under the provisions of this Constitution together with an explanatory memorandum as to the action taken thereon to be laid before each House of Parliament.
answers.notes: Article 281 wording verbatim in c51.

answers.quote: The President shall, within two years from the commencement of this Constitution and thereafter at the expiration of every fifth year or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary, by order constitute a Finance Commission which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be appointed by the President.
answers.notes: Stmt 1 per c49 (every fifth year or earlier); stmt 2 per c50 (distribution of net proceeds). Both true.
